meaning.en: The state or quality of being contradictory.
meaning.vi: Trạng thái hoặc chất lượng trái ngược nhau.

sentences.en: The contradictoriness and ambivalence of racist discourses and interactions are produced by a complex combination of social and psychic structures and forces.

sentences.en: Once again we see here that contradictoriness is no barrier to the maintenance of sexist stereotypes.

sentences.en: To understand the contradictoriness of Nietzsche the philosopher, as well as of Nietzsche the man, one must understand the concept of coincidentia oppositorum – the coincidence of opposites.
